title: The Ex Brought Someone
old_caption:
You were having the best night, and then your ex walked in with someone new.
Missing them is allowed. Say hi, keep it short and kind, then go back to your own night.

title: Everyone Has a Dating Tip
old_caption:
Single at a dinner where every couple has a tip for you.
They mean well, and you can still say thanks, I'm good. Then tell them what you're excited about.

title: Couples' Game Night
old_caption:
Every team at game night is a couple. Yours is just you.
Play as yourself and ask who's free to join. Sometimes the best teammate is someone's grandma.

title: Walking In Alone
old_caption:
Walking into a party where you only know the host is hard, and the urge to leave is real.
You don't need the whole room. Ask one person one question and see where it goes.

title: Saturday In, on Purpose
old_caption:
Everyone's posting their Saturday night out, and you're home in pyjamas.
A night in is a plan, not a backup. If it's what you want, enjoy it on purpose.

title: Aries Is Running Late
old_caption:
They're 20 minutes late. One Aries texts first, one just shows up yelling about traffic.
Late happens. The heads-up is the green flag.

title: Taurus Tries Your Favourite
old_caption:
You cooked your favourite dish for them. Do they ask for the recipe or order a sandwich?
Curious about your thing is the keeper move.

title: Gemini, Left on Read
old_caption:
Three hours on read, then "lol." Sound familiar?
Everyone gets busy. Saying so is what makes it a green flag.

title: Cancer, the Cancelled Plans
old_caption:
You cancelled because you're exhausted. Their reply tells you everything.
Rest, a rain check and zero guilt trip.

title: Leo Gets a Compliment
old_caption:
Tell a Leo they look great and watch closely.
The green flag takes the compliment and hands one right back.
